atoms.text: Now Bella is going to show you around the middle course of some rivers.

instruction.text: Can you put together the definition of middle course? Select the sentence parts in the correct order.

atoms.sound: The middle course is where the river slows, widens and bends.

instruction.text: We’re at the River Severn in England. Select the big bend to learn more.

feedback.end: When rivers widen and slow down, they drop the soil from earlier and create these bends. We call them meanders.

instruction.text: This is the Wye Valley in England. Select the river to learn more.

feedback.end: Here, the river has carved out a valley! Valleys are the low land in between hills and mountains and are often created by rivers.

instruction.text: This is the Grand Canyon in North America. Select the rocky outcrop to learn more.

feedback.end: The Colorado River has created a very dramatic type of valley called a canyon. This process took millions of years!

instruction.text: We’re back at the Nile. Find the sailing boat to learn more.

feedback.end: In the middle part of the Nile, the river has slowed down and widened a lot. It is even big enough for large boats!

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Answer Bella’s questions.

atoms.a: “What could we use to see how fast water travels down a river?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14'>What could we use to see how fast water travels down a river?</voice>

feedback.correct: Nice thinking! We can drop a stick into the river and see how quickly it moves with the water.
feedback.wrong: A piano wouldn’t be very useful here!

atoms.a: “What could we use to measure how quickly the stick travels?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f14'>What could we use to measure how quickly the stick travels</voice>

feedback.correct: Exactly! We can use a stopwatch to time how quickly the stick travels over a set distance.
feedback.wrong: A microphone wouldn’t be very useful here!

instruction.text: You stand on the bridge and drop the stick in the river. In which direction will the stick travel initially?

atoms.a: The middle course of the river is where we find its source.
In the middle course, the river slows down and widens.
A meander is a bend in the river.
It took a few days for a river to create the Grand Canyon.
